name: NEWA World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Held by Psycho Stud through the fed's own attested run; this collection's holdings do not trace the lineage before or after.

name: NEWA United States Championship
epitaph: Changed hands from Mr. Irrestible to "Shotgun" Sammy Cooper on 22 March 1997; also claimed by a rival tag-title claimant from an outside promotion, WNWA, an angle the fed's own newsletter treats as live but does not resolve in this collection's holdings.

name: NEWA World Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Held by the Hate Machine through the fed's own attested run, with the Nobles as the chief challengers; the fed's own December retrospective narrates the belts later changing hands to Jack Diamond and a tag partner, and finally to Midnight Rampage, ahead of the fed's own closure.
